basic_details.job_title: NAM Kerala Physiotherapist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: Applicants must not be more than 40 years of age as of 1 October 2026.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | physiotherapist: Graduation/Post Graduation in Physiotherapy approved by recognized University

selection_process: The selection process includes a written exam followed by an interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.nam.kerala.gov.in to download the application form and notification.
Fill out the application form with the required details in capital letters.
Affix a passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving educational qualifications and age.

Submit the filled application form either directly by hand or through post to the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, 5th Floor, Arogya Bhavan Building, near Ayurveda College, Thiruvananthapuram-695001.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 14 October 2026 by 05:00 PM. Applications sent via email will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Separate individual intimation letters or separate call letters will not be sent from the office for the interview; candidates must attend on the specified date and time. A written test is expected to be conducted as part of the selection. Candidates must bring original certificates to prove education and age on the day of the interview. Applications sent through email will not be considered. Applications must reach the specified office address on or before the last date and time.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for NAM Kerala Physiotherapist?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by National Ayush Mission Kerala (NAM Kerala).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NAM Kerala Physiotherapist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 anticipatory vacancy available for the Physiotherapist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 14 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation or Post Graduation in Physiotherapy approved by a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as of 1 October 2026.
